'''Jeffrey Brian Remmel''' (October 12, 1948{{Snd}} September 29, 2017) was an American mathematician employed by the [[University of California, San Diego]].<ref name="Robbins">{{Cite web |last=Robbins |first=Gary |date=October 6, 2017 |title=Renowned UC San Diego mathematician Jeff Remmel dies unexpectedly |url=https://www.sandiegouniontribune.com/news/science/sd-me-jeffrey-remmel-20171006-story.html |access-date=January 11, 2024 |website=[[San Diego Union-Tribune]] |language=en-US}} Republished in the ''[https://www.chicagotribune.com/sd-me-jeffrey-remmel-20171006-story.html Chicago Tribune]''.</ref> At the time of his death he held a [[distinguished professor]]ship—his title was Distinguished Professor of Mathematics;<ref name="Boggs">{{Cite web |last1=Boggs|first1=Steven|author-link=Steven Boggs|last2=Ni|first2=Lei|title=Jeffrey B. Remmel|url=https://senate.universityofcalifornia.edu/in-memoriam/files/jeffrey-b-remmel.html|access-date=January 11, 2024|website=Academic Senate|publisher=[[University of California]]|author-link2=Lei Ni}} Also published as a [https://mathweb.ucsd.edu/~mathconf/memorials/jeffrey-remmel/ memorial by UC San Diego].</ref> he also held a position as a professor of [[computer science]].<ref name="Home Page">{{Cite web |title=Jeff Remmel's Home Page |url=https://mathweb.ucsd.edu/~remmel/ |access-date=January 12, 2024 |website= |publisher=[[UC San Diego]]}}</ref>

== Personal life ==
Remmel was born on October 12, 1948, in [[Clintonville, Wisconsin]].<ref name="Kitaev">{{Cite journal |last1=Kitaev |first1=Sergey |author-link=Sergey Kitaev |last2=Mendes |first2=Anthony |date=February 19, 2021 |title=The Combinatorics of Jeff Remmel |journal=Enumerative Combinatorics and Applications |volume=1 |issue=2 |arxiv=2102.07269 |id={{QID|124254336}} |article-number=S1H2}}</ref> He died aged 68 at [[Scripps Memorial Hospital]] in [[La Jolla, California]] on September 29, 2017,<ref name="Robbins" /> with a reported cause of death being a [[heart attack]].<ref>{{Cite web |last1=Ni|first1=Lei|last2=Buss|first2=Sam|author-link2=Sam Buss|date=September 30, 2017|title=[FOM] Sad news, Jeff Remmel|url=https://cs.nyu.edu/pipermail/fom/2017-September/020617.html|access-date=January 13, 2024|author-link=Lei Ni}}</ref>

== Education ==
Remmel received a [[Bachelor of Arts]] degree in mathematics from [[Swarthmore College]] in 1970. Later, he received two degrees from [[Cornell University]]—a [[Master of Science]] in mathematics and a [[Doctor of Philosophy]], also in math (1972 and 1974, respectively).<ref name="Home Page" /> At Cornell, he was advised by [[Anil Nerode]], and his dissertation was entitled ''Co-recursively Enumerable Structures''.<ref name=":3">{{Cite journal |date=December 2017 |title=Notices |journal=The Bulletin of Symbolic Logic |volume=23 |issue=4 |pages=540–545 |doi=10.1017/bsl.2017.40 |issn=1079-8986 |jstor=26409199}} Also appears in [https://aslonline.org/files/newsletters/pdfs/November2017newsletter.pdf Association for Symbolic Logic November 2017 newsletter].</ref>

== Career ==
After obtaining his Ph.D.,{{Efn|One source attests that he had not officially completed his Ph.D. upon joining UC San Diego.<ref name="Kitaev"/>}} though before he had published a single paper,<ref name="Kitaev" /> Remmel joined the faculty of the [[University of California, San Diego]] as an [[assistant professor]], where he worked for his entire career.<ref name="Boggs" /> Remmel was noted for his successful publication record in two separate fields—[[logic]], in which he published in [[mathematical logic]]; and [[combinatorics]], where he published papers on [[algebraic combinatorics]].<ref name=":3" /> He published over 20 papers in logic with [[Victor W. Marek]],<ref>{{Cite web |last=Marek |first=Victor W. |author-link=Victor W. Marek |title=Comments on Logic and Knowledge Representation |url=https://www.cs.uky.edu/~marek/flaphotos.dir/mowa.pdf |journal=}}</ref> and Remmel's more prominent career in combinatorics included over 20 co-authored papers with [[Sergey Kitaev]].<ref name="Kitaev" /> A double issue of the ''Journal of Combinatorics''{{Efn|{{ISSN|2156-3527}}; {{eISSN|2150-959X}}.}} was published in his memory.<ref>{{Cite journal |last=Loehr |first=Nicholas A. |date=2019 |title=Foreword: Special Issue In Memory of Jeff Remmel |url=https://www.intlpress.com/site/pub/files/_fulltext/journals/joc/2019/0010/0003/JOC-2019-0010-0003-f001.pdf |journal=Journal of Combinatorics |volume=10 |issue=2 |pages=409–410}}</ref>

Remmel's work is highly cited in the fields of [[vector space]]s, including [[computably enumerable set]]s and vector spaces.{{Efn|See, for example:
*{{Cite journal |last=Kalantari |first=Iraj |date=1978 |title=Major Subspaces of Recursively Enumerable Vector Spaces |url=https://www.jstor.org/stable/2272828 |journal=The Journal of Symbolic Logic |volume=43 |issue=2 |pages=293–303 |doi=10.2307/2272828 |jstor=2272828 |issn=0022-4812|url-access=subscription }}
*{{Cite journal |last1=Downey |first1=Rod G. |author-link=Rod G. Downey |last2=Stob |first2=M. |date=1986 |title=Structural interactions of the recursively enumerable T- and W-degrees |url=https://digitalcommons.calvin.edu/calvin_facultypubs/478 |journal=Annals of Pure and Applied Logic |language=en |volume=31 |pages=205–236 |doi=10.1016/0168-0072(86)90071-0|doi-access=free |url-access=subscription }}
*{{Citation |last1=Dimitrov |first1=Rumen D. |chapter=The Lattice of Computably Enumerable Vector Spaces |date=2017 |title=Computability and Complexity |volume=10010 |pages=366–393 |editor-last=Day |editor-first=Adam |place=Cham |publisher=Springer International Publishing |language=en |doi=10.1007/978-3-319-50062-1_23 |isbn=978-3-319-50061-4 |last2=Harizanov |first2=Valentina |editor2-last=Fellows |editor2-first=Michael |editor3-last=Greenberg |editor3-first=Noam |editor4-last=Khoussainov |editor4-first=Bakhadyr |mode=cs1 |author-link2=Valentina Harizanov |chapter-url=https://home.gwu.edu/~harizanv/FINAL436364_1_En_23_Chapter_OnlinePDF%281%29.pdf}}
}}
